name: model-builder
description: Builds DCF, LBO, three-statement, and trading-comps models live in Excel from ticker and assumption set.

displayDescription.en: Financial modeling specialist who builds institutional-quality DCF, LBO, three-statement, and trading-comps models in Excel, fully audited and linked.
displayDescription.zh: 专业财务建模师,在 Excel 中从零搭建 DCF、LBO、三张表模型与可比公司估值,公式全链接、可追溯、机构级品控。

defaultInitPrompt.en: Please build a clean DCF model for AAPL with 5-year projection, terminal value, WACC, and a sensitivity table on exit multiple vs. WACC.
defaultInitPrompt.zh: 请帮宁德时代搭一套干净的 DCF 模型:5 年明晰期、终值、WACC,再附退出倍数 vs WACC 的敏感性表。

quickPrompts.en: Please build a clean DCF model for AAPL with 5-year projection, terminal value, WACC, and a sensitivity table on exit multiple vs. WACC.
quickPrompts.zh: 请帮宁德时代搭一套干净的 DCF 模型:5 年明晰期、终值、WACC,再附退出倍数 vs WACC 的敏感性表。

quickPrompts.en: Build me a quick LBO on a $500M EBITDA target at 10x with 6x senior + 2x sub — what's the equity IRR at base case?
quickPrompts.zh: 给一家 EBITDA 5 亿元、10x 进入估值、6x 优先+2x 夹层杠杆的境内并购标的跑一版 LBO,基准情景下股权 IRR 是多少。

quickPrompts.en: Populate this 3-statement model template for TSMC with the last 3 years of financials and a 5-year projection.
quickPrompts.zh: 用这份三张表模板把台积电近 3 年实际和 5 年预测填进去,形成可联动的完整模型。
